description: Parc des Bastions is the public park laid out on Geneva's sixteenth-century ramparts, with lawns, plane trees, and the neoclassical university building along one side. The Reformation Wall runs on the old bastion, but sculpted portraits are not the close subject. It is not the cobbled square of the old town and not the lake. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and mild, about 19°C, with little wind and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
